title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1, section 14 (Ward Lake)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 1 No Shooting, Hunting or Trapping Areas (Section 2)
Ward Lake
14 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of Grand Forks within the following described boundaries: Lot 30 of Lots 334, 1494 and 333, Similkameen Division of Yale District, Plan 8423. [am. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 1.]
